item.title: Argentina commemorate win against England at World Cup 2026 with special day
item.summary: AFA to establish ‘National Football Teams Day’ for 15 July Post-match celebrations saw Falklands banner displayed Argentina’s World Cup semi-final win over England last month is being commemorated by the country’s football association. The Argentinian football association (AFA) has established 15 July – the date of the 2-1 win in Atlanta – as its ‘National Football Teams Day’, following a meeting of its executive board on Wednesday.
